_note: Provisional EU AI Act obligation keys used by the classification spec and the golden suite. Phase 3 turns each into a full requirement (artefact, crosswalk to ISO/IEC 42001 and NIST AI RMF). 'applies' is a plain-language statement of the rule in docs/v2/classification-spec.md §5. Dates reflect Reg. (EU) 2024/1689 as amended by Reg. (EU) 2026/1744.

obligations.title: Prohibited: crime prediction solely by profiling
Prohibited: emotion recognition at work or in education
Prohibited: biometric categorisation of sensitive traits
Prohibited: real-time RBI for law enforcement
Document the assessment that an Annex III system is not high-risk
Register the Art. 6(3) non-high-risk system
obligations.verification: The Commission proposal deleted this registration duty; confirm whether Reg. (EU) 2026/1744 kept that deletion.

obligations.title: Technical documentation (simplified form for SMEs and small mid-caps)
Transparency and instructions for use to deployers
Quality management system (proportionate for SMEs and small mid-caps)
EU declaration of conformity and CE marking
Register the high-risk system in the EU database
obligations.applies: High-risk under Annex III (except point 2, registered nationally), provider.

obligations.title: Importer obligations
obligations.applies: High-risk, importer or distributor role selected.

obligations.title: Distributor obligations
obligations.applies: High-risk, importer or distributor role selected.

obligations.title: Deployer obligations (use per instructions, oversight, input data, monitoring, logs)
Inform workers and their representatives before workplace use
Inform people that they are subject to the high-risk system
obligations.applies: Annex III high-risk (not point 2), deployer, the system makes or assists decisions about people other than staff.

obligations.title: Fundamental rights impact assessment
obligations.applies: Annex III high-risk (not point 2), deployer that is a public authority or private entity providing public services, or any deployer under point 5(b) or 5(c).

obligations.title: Public-authority deployer registration
obligations.applies: Annex III high-risk (not point 2), deployer that is a public authority.

obligations.title: Explanation of individual decisions to affected persons
obligations.applies: Annex III high-risk (not point 2), deployer, severity material or serious.

obligations.title: Tell people they are interacting with AI
Machine-readable marking of synthetic content
obligations.applies: Generates synthetic audio, image, video or text, provider.
obligations.verification: Sources differ on whether 2 Dec 2026 applies to all systems or only those placed on the market before 2 Aug 2026.

obligations.title: Inform people exposed to emotion recognition or biometric categorisation
obligations.applies: Emotion recognition or biometric categorisation, deployer.

obligations.title: Disclose deepfakes and AI-generated public-interest text
obligations.applies: Deepfake or public-interest text without human editorial responsibility, deployer.

obligations.title: GPAI models with systemic risk
obligations.applies: GPAI model provider and the model meets the systemic-risk threshold (always an open question in v2).
